title: Sync documentation with current Zod schema state
body:
Documentation referenced outdated field type counts and protocol structures. Manual docs now reflect the actual 49 Zod schemas across 5 protocol categories.

## Changes

**Field Type Documentation**
- Updated count: 23+/30+ → 35 types across all docs
- Added missing types: `slider`, `qrcode`
- Clarified `geolocation` as `location` alias with detailed barcode format descriptions

**Protocol Structure (ARCHITECTURE.md)**
- Removed `[MISSING]`/`[PLANNED]` markers for implemented schemas
- Added: `filter`, `organization`, `audit`, `job` to System Protocol
- Updated AI Protocol: 8 schemas (agent, model-registry, rag-pipeline, nlq, conversation, cost, predictive, workflow-automation)

**Scope**
- 21 files: core docs, guides (EN/CN), specifications, tutorials, planning docs
- Excludes: Auto-generated reference docs in `content/docs/references/` (unchanged)

## Field Type Categories

```typescript
// Basic (6): text, textarea, number, boolean, date, datetime
// Rich (8): email, phone, url, currency, percent, markdown, html, richtext
// Advanced (5): lookup, master_detail, formula, summary, autonumber
// Complex (5): address, location, file, image, avatar
// Enhanced (6): code, color, rating, slider, signature, qrcode
// Media (3): image, file, avatar
```

All references now aligned with `src/data/field.zod.ts` FieldType enum (35 types).
